plan.notes: Official 4-year plan of study published in the Sam Houston State University 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog (catalog.shsu.edu). Courses, credits, and semester placement transcribed verbatim from the catalog plan grid; catalog footnotes preserved as choice notes. Credit ranges resolved to the minimum (catalog totals are ranges).

courses.title: Human Anatomy & Physiology I 2,
courses.choice_note: Select one of the following: CHEM 1406 & CHEM 1411 or PHYS 1305 & PHYS 1105 or PHYS 1301 and PHYS 1101 . Satisfies Core Curriculum requirement for Component Area III (Life and Physical Science). BIOL 2401 and BIOL 2402 may be used as transfer courses for this requirement; please see a SAM Center advisor for more details.
